why: The signal-controlled crossing on Sherwood Drive by Jemima Way sits 5 m from the end of its way (the way is split at the next node), and the generator leaves out a crossing within 8 m of a way's end, so the lights would stand with no crossing. Moved 4.5 m back along Sherwood Drive's own line (and the cycleway crossing it): the crossing is then drawn where it is.
